correctness.rationale: Over any characteristic-two field and chain evolution algebra e_i²=e_(i+1), equal-input Rota–Baxter equations force R(e_i)=Q^(i-1)(R(e_1)), with Q(v)=v². Unequal-basis equations reduce exactly to b_(s+t-1)b_t^(2^(s-1))=b_s b_t^(2^s), s>=2,t>=1,s+t-1<=n-1. A first interior nonzero coordinate k yields the sparse residue-class Frobenius geometric progression, b_1=0 or 1 and free terminal b_n; absent interior coefficients yield the terminal-support class. This proves an exhaustive disjoint normal form over imperfect as well as perfect fields. For F_q, q a 2-power, counts (2n-3)q²-(2n-4)q and rank frequencies 1 at rank0, q-1 rank1, q(q-1) each rank 2..n-1, (n-1)q(q-1) at full rank. Direct independent exhaustive q=2 basis-identity enumeration for n=2..8 agreed. These finite checks corroborate, but all n/q follow from coefficient equations.
